title: A Crown for the Salt
author: Paloma Amberdale
blurb: Edmund Ravensworth, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
